description: `platform.status` (S54 T2, SP1) composes the whole derived plane in one read: retrieval, graph and usage blocks, each answered THROUGH the same seam its own subsystem door serves — a second staleness formula would be a second truth. Every block carries its own state word (available, stale, building, unwired, error); the block shape never changes with the state. Here retrieval is stale with one component and no embedding route to price a pass (the availability sentence, quoted from the retrieval leaf, never paraphrased), the graph is stale with a root that was listed but never built (the ONLY stale the graph block may claim — the seam has no staleness field to invent from), and usage is available with a known cost. Unwired is the ABSENT seam's honest word, not a zero.

retrieval.availability: no embedding route to price the pass
